_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26. The source is a Nigeria NDLEA allegation and arrest announcement, not a court finding. The couple was declared wanted on 2024-05-19 and three named associates had been arrested; no later charge, conviction, or current-status update was verified in the reviewed NDLEA archive, Nigerian reporting, or India-side searches. Status dates reflect the last verified source, not present whereabouts. NDLEA says four network members were arrested, but names only three; the unnamed person is omitted. Unrelated arrests in the same weekly release are excluded. Country markers represent source-supported alleged historical operating associations, not nationality, residence alone, arrest venue alone, or destinations. No precise locations, routes, enforcement gaps, or photos without verified reuse rights.
